rules.statement: Only linked execution evidence adds a filled position; validation/ACK alone does not.
Cancel command, native remainder termination and actual executed position closure are distinct.
Keep operation identity and obligations until actual reconciliation; no blind send-again.
Dedupe transport event IDs and economic deal IDs separately; conflicts remain blocking incidents.
Cancellation arrival may precede the final fill record; retain missing execution quantities.
Unknown is not zero. No net account result until fee/currency/FX evidence is sufficient.

integration_requirements.charge_identity: Account+source+economic charge identity and fee kind must distinguish costs already represented by Deal.commission from new Cashflow charges. No unlinked duplicate debit.
integration_requirements.fee_reordering: Existing reducer consumes the receipt for DEAL_COST_CONFIRMED before its Deal exists. Retain unresolved ORIGINAL payload durably and reconcile it after exact deal identity; design/migration still required.
integration_requirements.account_dimensions: Do not drop S02 currency/model/provider identity when mapping legacy broker/id/environment.
integration_requirements.time_precision: S02 uses six fractional UTC digits, legacy reducer exactly three; do not silently truncate execution time. A versioned projection must retain original time.
integration_requirements.quantity: pieces/units/lots and multiplier must be explicit; 36 MPR1 pieces are not an arbitrary broker volume.
integration_requirements.cash_and_fx: The archived reducer is a quantity/cost projection, not an account cash writer. Versioned FX, partial realization allocation, cashflows and net trade definitions remain unimplemented here.
integration_requirements.authority: Valid schemas, cash arithmetic and state projection do not authorize an order.

known_gap.name: fee_before_fill_nonconvergence
